story.title: Farah DEBUNKS fire rumours, urges media to verify before publishing
story.summary: Filmmaker-choreographer Farah Khan has criticised online portals for sharing a video wrongly claiming a fire at her Mumbai home. She clarified the blaze was in an under-construction building and urged media to verify facts. Meanwhile, she recently revamped her bedroom and announced her next film with Shah Rukh Khan will start shooting in December.
